class Solution:
    def solveSudoku(self, board):
        rows, cols, boxes = [0] * 9, [0] * 9, [0] * 9
        empties = []
        for r in range(9):
            for c in range(9):
                if board[r][c] == '.': empties.append((r, c))
                else:
                    bit = 1 << int(board[r][c])
                    rows[r] |= bit
                    cols[c] |= bit
                    boxes[r // 3 * 3 + c // 3] |= bit
        def solve(k):
            if k == len(empties): return True
            r, c = empties[k]
            b = r // 3 * 3 + c // 3
            used = rows[r] | cols[c] | boxes[b]
            for d in range(1, 10):
                bit = 1 << d
                if not used & bit:
                    board[r][c] = str(d)
                    rows[r] |= bit
                    cols[c] |= bit
                    boxes[b] |= bit
                    if solve(k + 1): return True
                    rows[r] ^= bit
                    cols[c] ^= bit
                    boxes[b] ^= bit
            board[r][c] = '.'
            return False
        solve(0)

class Solution:
    def permuteUnique(self, nums):
        nums = sorted(nums)
        used = [False] * len(nums)
        res, path = [], []
        def go():
            if len(path) == len(nums):
                res.append(path[:])
                return
            for i in range(len(nums)):
                if used[i]: continue
                if i and nums[i] == nums[i - 1] and not used[i - 1]: continue
                used[i] = True
                path.append(nums[i])
                go()
                path.pop()
                used[i] = False
        go()
        return res

class Solution:
    def permuteUnique(self, nums):
        cnt = Counter(nums)
        res, path = [], []
        def go():
            if len(path) == len(nums):
                res.append(path[:])
                return
            for v in sorted(cnt):
                if cnt[v] == 0: continue
                cnt[v] -= 1
                path.append(v)
                go()
                path.pop()
                cnt[v] += 1
        go()
        return res

        k %= n

        fast = slow = head

        while fast.next: fast = fast.next; slow = slow.next
        new = slow.next; slow.next = None; fast.next = head

class Solution:
    def maximumGap(self, nums):
        n = len(nums)
        if n < 2: return 0
        lo, hi = min(nums), max(nums)
        if lo == hi: return 0
        size = max(1, (hi - lo) // (n - 1))
        count = (hi - lo) // size + 1
        mins, maxs = [None] * count, [None] * count
        for x in nums:
            i = (x - lo) // size
            mins[i] = x if mins[i] is None else min(mins[i], x)
            maxs[i] = x if maxs[i] is None else max(maxs[i], x)

            if mins[i] is None: continue
            best = max(best, mins[i] - prev)
            prev = maxs[i]

        self.rows = [0] * n

    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.b = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
    def move(self, row, col, player):
        n, b = self.n, self.b
        b[row][col] = player
        if all(b[row][j] == player for j in range(n)): return player
        if all(b[i][col] == player for i in range(n)): return player
        if row == col and all(b[i][i] == player for i in range(n)): return player

        self.body = deque([(0, 0)])

        r, c = r + dr, c + dc
        if not (0 <= r < self.h and 0 <= c < self.w): return -1
        ate = self.fi < len(self.food) and [r, c] == self.food[self.fi]
        tail = self.body[0]
        if not ate:
            self.body.popleft()
            self.cells.discard(tail)
        if (r, c) in self.cells: return -1
        self.body.append((r, c))
        self.cells.add((r, c))
        if ate:
            self.fi += 1
            self.score += 1
        return self.score

class LFUCache:
    def __init__(self, capacity):
        self.cap = capacity
        self.val = {}
        self.freq = {}
        self.buckets = defaultdict(OrderedDict)
        self.minf = 0
    def _touch(self, key):
        f = self.freq[key]
        del self.buckets[f][key]
        if not self.buckets[f] and self.minf == f: self.minf += 1
        self.freq[key] = f + 1
        self.buckets[f + 1][key] = None
    def get(self, key):
        if key not in self.val: return -1
        self._touch(key)
        return self.val[key]
    def put(self, key, value):
        if self.cap == 0: return
        if key in self.val:
            self.val[key] = value
            self._touch(key)
            return
        if len(self.val) >= self.cap:
            old, _ = self.buckets[self.minf].popitem(last=False)
            del self.val[old]
            del self.freq[old]
        self.val[key] = value
        self.freq[key] = 1
        self.buckets[1][key] = None
        self.minf = 1

class BoundedBlockingQueue:
    def __init__(self, capacity):
        self.q = deque()
        self.free = threading.Semaphore(capacity)
